name: Anahata Yoga Retreat
technique: Hatha, Karma, Bhakti, Jnana and Raja Yoga, meditation, mouna (silence), fire rituals
retreatOptions: Nightly stays up to a month-long 'Yogic Life Skills' immersion
about: An eco-ashram bordering Abel Tasman National Park combining classical yoga paths with meditation and periods of silence. Runs a karma-yoga caretaker exchange (cooking, gardening, maintenance for accommodation); meditation-centrality is somewhat shared with general yogic lifestyle practice, included with that caveat.
workNotes: Formal karma-yoga exchange program available, not mandatory for all guests.
